sentiment.rationale: The document reports record automotive revenue up 29%, record energy storage deployments and margins, and record free cash flow of about $4B. Forward guidance includes a concrete robotaxi timeline (no safety drivers in parts of Austin by year end) and a substantial capex increase for AI initiatives, indicating raised forward expectations. Tariff impacts of over $400M and rising opex are noted but do not offset the strong operational momentum and forward-looking autonomy catalyst.

summary.revenue: Automotive revenue up 29%, with deliveries up across regions (Greater China and APAC +33%, North America +28%, EMEA +25%).
summary.guidance: Capex about $9B this year with a substantial increase expected in 2026 for AI initiatives including Optimus. Robotaxi expansion targeted, with safety drivers removed in parts of Austin by year end.
summary.margin: Automotive margin excluding credits rose from 15% to 15.4%.
key_risks: Tariff impacts above $400M in the quarter across autos and energy.
Intensifying competition and cost pressure in energy storage.
Rising opex from R&D, legal proceedings and AI-linked equity awards.
key_opportunities: Record energy storage deployments, gross profit and margins.
Robotaxi expansion with safety drivers removed in parts of Austin by year end.
AI initiatives including Optimus with substantial capex increase expected in 2026.
